summary: Resumed conversations keep finding their checkpoint much longer
details: The checkpoint directory keeps 65536 manifests instead of 8192, so it forgets conversations far less often while their pages are still in L2; --checkpoint-index-max-entries changes it.
Checkpoint lookups use an index, so a larger directory does not slow them down. The first start on an existing directory builds that index once (about 3 s for 8192 manifests).
